cugold.name: Copper / gold ratio (×1000)
cugold.note: Rises when markets price stronger industrial growth.

hygief.name: High-yield vs Treasuries (HYG/IEF)
hygief.note: Credit risk appetite. Falls when credit spreads widen.

c3m10y.name: Yield curve 3m10y
c3m10y.note: 10-year minus 3-month. The spread behind the New York Fed’s recession-probability model.

be10.name: 10-year breakeven inflation
be10.note: Inflation priced by bond markets for the next 10 years.

be5y5y.name: 5y5y forward inflation
be5y5y.note: Inflation expected 5–10 years out. A market gauge the Fed watches for anchored expectations.

pol_BR.name: Policy rate — Banco Central do Brasil

fedassets.name: Fed balance sheet (total assets)
fedassets.note: Weekly H.4.1. Rising = the Fed adding liquidity.

cli_g20.name: OECD leading indicator — G20
cli_g20.note: 100 = long-run trend. Above and rising = growth accelerating.

calendar.title: India jobs: PLFS monthly bulletin (Oct)
calendar.detail: Urban and rural unemployment rate. Calendar date 15 Nov was a Sunday, so it moves to the next working day.

calendar.title: FOMC minutes (27–28 Oct meeting)
calendar.detail: Two members dissented in favour of a hike. Look for how many others leaned that way, and the balance-sheet discussion.

calendar.title: China loan prime rates (LPR)
calendar.detail: Set on the 20th each month. A cut signals more stimulus, good for metals and EM.

calendar.title: Nifty monthly F&O expiry
calendar.detail: Moved to Monday because 24 Nov is a market holiday. Expect volatility near the close.

calendar.title: US PCE inflation (Oct) + GDP Q3 (second estimate)
calendar.detail: PCE is the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge. Watch core PCE month on month.

calendar.title: US markets closed (Thanksgiving); early close 27 Nov
OPEC+ meeting (seven-country group)
calendar.detail: Sets January output; on 1 Nov the seven kept December output at September’s level. Higher oil widens India’s import bill and weighs on the rupee.

calendar.title: India GDP, Q2 FY27 (Jul–Sep)
calendar.detail: Growth momentum versus RBI projections; nominal GDP drives earnings and tax revenue.

calendar.title: India industrial production, IIP (Oct)
calendar.detail: Calendar date 28 Nov is a Saturday, so it moves to the next working day, alongside GDP.

calendar.title: MSCI November review: rebalance at the close
calendar.detail: Implemented as of the 30 Nov close, so index funds trade then. In India, LIC, Adani Green and Meesho join the Standard Index and PI Industries leaves it.

calendar.title: China official PMIs (Nov)
calendar.detail: Published by NBS on the last day of the month. Above 50 = expansion.

calendar.title: India GST collections (Nov)
calendar.detail: Published on the 1st, weekends included. A real-time read on consumption and tax buoyancy.

calendar.title: RBI monetary policy decision
calendar.detail: MPC meets 2–4 Dec after hiking to 5.50% in October. Watch the CPI forecast, stance and liquidity measures.

calendar.title: US jobs report — non-farm payrolls (Nov)
calendar.detail: Payrolls, unemployment rate and wage growth.

calendar.title: FOMC decision + projections (dot plot)
calendar.detail: Meeting 8–9 Dec. New dot plot and economic projections; press conference 30 minutes after.

calendar.title: US CPI inflation (Nov)
calendar.detail: Headline and core CPI. Lands the day after the Fed decision.

calendar.title: India CPI inflation (Nov)
calendar.detail: Calendar date 12 Dec is a Saturday, so it moves to the next working day.

calendar.title: India WPI inflation (Nov)
calendar.detail: Usually released on the 14th by the Office of the Economic Adviser.

calendar.title: US retail sales (Nov)
calendar.detail: Holiday-season spending; about 70% of US GDP is consumption.

calendar.title: ECB monetary policy decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 16–17 Dec; press conference on the 17th.

calendar.title: Bank of England decision
calendar.detail: First meeting after the 5 Nov hike to 4%.

calendar.title: Bank of Japan decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 17–18 Dec. BoJ hikes can unwind yen carry trades and hit global risk assets.

calendar.title: US quarterly options and futures expiry ("quad witching")
calendar.detail: Third Friday of the quarter-end month; heavy volume, index rebalancing.

calendar.title: China loan prime rates (LPR)
calendar.detail: The 20th falls on a Sunday.

calendar.title: US GDP Q3 (third estimate) + PCE inflation (Nov)
US and Indian markets closed (Christmas)
calendar.detail: On both the NSE 2026 and NYSE holiday lists.

calendar.title: FOMC minutes (8–9 Dec meeting)
calendar.detail: Three weeks after the meeting.

calendar.title: India GDP: first advance estimate, FY27
calendar.detail: The full-year growth estimate the Union Budget is built on.

calendar.title: India Q3 FY27 results season begins (IT services usually first)
calendar.detail: Week of 11 Jan by convention. Watch guidance from IT services and private banks.

calendar.title: US Q4 earnings season begins (large banks first)
calendar.detail: Mid-January by convention. Net interest income, credit costs and buyback plans.

calendar.title: US retail sales (Dec)
calendar.detail: Holiday-season spending.

calendar.title: US markets closed (Martin Luther King Jr. Day)
Bank of Japan decision + Outlook Report
calendar.detail: Meeting 21–22 Jan, with new growth and inflation forecasts.

calendar.title: Nifty monthly F&O expiry
calendar.detail: The last Tuesday, 26 Jan, is Republic Day, so expiry moves to Monday.

calendar.title: NSE / BSE closed (Republic Day)
calendar.detail: Always a market holiday; NSE publishes its 2027 list in December.

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 26–27 Jan (tentative until confirmed at the December meeting).

calendar.title: US GDP Q4 (advance) + PCE inflation (Dec)
calendar.detail: First read on Q4 growth, the day after the Fed decision.

calendar.title: Union Budget FY28
calendar.detail: Presented on 1 Feb by convention; the date is confirmed when Parliament’s budget session is notified. Fiscal deficit, borrowing, capex, capital gains tax.

calendar.title: RBI monetary policy decision
calendar.detail: MPC meets 3–5 Feb, days after the Budget.

calendar.title: US jobs report — non-farm payrolls (Jan), with annual revisions
calendar.detail: Includes the annual benchmark revision to payrolls.

calendar.title: MSCI February index review announced
calendar.detail: Changes take effect 1 Mar. Drives passive FPI flows into India.

calendar.title: India WPI inflation (Jan)
calendar.detail: The 14th falls on a Sunday.

calendar.title: FOMC minutes (26–27 Jan meeting)
calendar.detail: Three weeks after the meeting.

calendar.title: US PCE inflation (Jan) + GDP Q4 (second estimate)
India GDP Q3 FY27 + second advance estimate
calendar.detail: Also revises FY26 and finalises FY25 growth.

calendar.title: MSCI February review: rebalance at the close
calendar.detail: Changes take effect 1 Mar, so index funds trade at the close of the prior trading day.

calendar.title: India industrial production, IIP (Jan)
calendar.detail: Calendar date 28 Feb is a Sunday, so it moves to the next working day.

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 16–17 Mar (tentative). The Fed has not yet marked which 2027 meetings come with projections (dot plot). US clocks move to daylight time on 14 Mar.

calendar.title: NSE / BSE closed (Good Friday)
calendar.detail: NSE has not yet published its 2027 holiday list; Good Friday has been a market holiday every year.

calendar.title: India industrial production, IIP (Feb)
calendar.detail: Calendar date 28 Mar is a Sunday, so it moves to the next working day.

calendar.title: US PCE inflation (Feb) + GDP Q4 (third estimate)
India fiscal year-end (FY27)
calendar.detail: Advance tax, fiscal deficit outturn and year-end liquidity tightness.

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 27–28 Apr (tentative).

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 8–9 Jun (tentative).

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 27–28 Jul (tentative).

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 14–15 Sep (tentative).

calendar.title: FOMC strategy meeting (no rate decision)
calendar.detail: Meeting 26–27 Oct, set aside for monetary policy strategy. No rate vote or policy statement is expected.

calendar.title: FOMC decision
calendar.detail: Meeting 16–17 Nov (tentative); the last rate decision of 2027, replacing the usual December meeting. US clocks are back on standard time from 7 Nov.

horizon.title: State assembly elections: Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Goa, Manipur
horizon.detail: The Election Commission has not announced a schedule; reports expect dates after mid-December (in 2022 they were announced on 8 Jan). The UP result is read as a mid-term test for the central government.

horizon.title: Economic Survey FY27
horizon.when: Late January 2027, a few days before the Budget
horizon.detail: Tabled at the start of the Budget session (on 29 Jan in 2026). The government’s growth outlook for FY28.

horizon.title: US Treasury quarterly refunding announcement
horizon.detail: Coupon issuance sizes move long-term yields.

horizon.title: RBI Financial Stability Report
horizon.detail: Bank asset quality and systemic risk.
